page_title: HOL 2-2 STU | Holstein Kiel v Stuttgart 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Jamie Leweling goes off the pitch and Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
90+2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Holstein Kiel was in an offside position.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) was quite harsh and Bastian Dankert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

55' 2 - 2 Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
54' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) takes the set piece from outside the box. His shot heads towards the roof of the net, but Alexander Nubel dives and saves the effort, punching it onto the bar.
52' Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
51' 41:59 – the latest ball possession ratio.

46' 2 - 1 What a finish that is! Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) sees that Alexander Nubel is off his line and scores with a brilliant lob from the edge of the box. He makes it 2:1.
46' Half-time substitution. Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is replaced by Ermedin Demirovic.
46' Sebastian Hoeness has made a change at the break. Jacob Bruun Larsen has come on in place of Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).
46' The second half gets underway.

45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
41' Stuttgart hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
39' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) climbs high to connect with a cross heading towards the edge of the box and produces a poor header which goes well wide of the right post.
36' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 2:0.

32' Holstein Kiel players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
30' 1 - 1 Goal 1:1! Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
29' A pass lands at the feet of Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
27' Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
25' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well wide of the left post.
23' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:1.

18' Stuttgart keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
15' 0 - 1 Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb inside the left post. What a beautiful shot.

10' Some patient build-up play from Stuttgart as they look to unlock the defence.

5' A dangerous towering header by David Zec (Holstein Kiel) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
